mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which drives increased consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that typically triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0) or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS m/m > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL m/m > 0.5%) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong industrial production (INDPRO above 105.0) signals an economy approaching its peak, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is expected to tighten.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that typically leads to aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand for housing, which boosts economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST m/m > 0.5% and RSAFS m/m > 0.5%) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 1.0% signals aggressive Fed policy that typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0 during a monetary tightening cycle, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
